comment: Mr. Fuji's house, after the rescue: the PokE Flute grant, in the source's own order (pokered MrFujisHouse Fuji script): his quest line, the grant, the flute explanation. The source's obtain-fanfare line (_MrFujisHouseMrFujiReceivedPokeFluteText) is not a say step - the give_item step IS the grant. Gated on fuji_rescued (set by pokemon_tower_fuji_rescue.json) so the flute cannot be claimed before the rescue plays.
